changeSet.sql:
create or alter procedure [dbo].[GetScoreHistoryByObject] @assetUid uniqueidentifier, @scoreType int AS begin declare @date date = getutcdate()
select S.EffectiveDate as [EffectiveDate], S.[EndDate] as [EndDate], cast(S.Value * 100 as decimal(18,1)) as Score, A.ScoreType from metrics.Score S inner join metrics.Allocation A on A.Uid = S.AllocationUid and S.AssetUid = @assetUid and S.EffectiveDate <= @date and A.ScoreType = @scoreType and A.OverrideName is null end
changeSet.rollback:
create or alter procedure [dbo].[GetScoreHistoryByObject] @assetUid uniqueidentifier, @scoreType int AS begin declare @date date = getutcdate()
select EffectiveDate as [EffectiveDate], [EndDate] as [EndDate], cast(Value * 100 as decimal(18,1)) as Score, ScoreType from metrics.Score where AssetUid = @assetUid and EffectiveDate <= @date and ScoreType = @scoreType union select cast(@date as date) as [EffectiveDate], null as [EndDate], cast(Value * 100 as decimal(18,1)) as Score, ScoreType from metrics.Score S inner join ( select max(EffectiveDate) as EffectiveDate from metrics.Score where AssetUid = @assetUid and EffectiveDate <= @date and ScoreType = @scoreType ) M on M.EffectiveDate = S.EffectiveDate and S.AssetUid = @assetUid and ScoreType = @scoreType end
